title: Layout controls: delete the dead ones, keep the ones one in ten pages use
recommendation: Delete summary column insert/drag/remove, the drag-resize grip and the heading alignment bar on sections (hero keeps it); keep Wrap text, gallery columns and logo colour because customers use them on 18 to 38% of the blocks that have them.

questions.q: Adopt the one-in-ten rule as the test for layout controls?
questions.recommended: Yes. It is the same test as the usage audit, applied per control instead of per block.

questions.q: Alignment bar: delete on sections, keep on the hero?
questions.recommended: Yes. Stored alignments keep rendering, so no live page changes.

questions.q: Gallery columns: keep the stepper, or derive from the image count as the audit suggested?
questions.recommended: Keep the stepper. Deriving would change five live galleries and the stepper is one control.
